summary: Iter17 tested new features: (1) CSV import 2-step overwrite/skip flow + category assignment, (2) per-workspace timezone under Email/SMTP, (3) 'Send test to myself' button in campaign Send modal, (4) live iframe thumbnail on Campaigns list. Backend pytest (4/4) passed covering: PUT/GET /company/timezone persistence, /contacts/import mode=analyze returning {total,new,duplicates}, mode=import with overwrite=true updates existing, overwrite=false skips duplicates while still importing new, POST /campaigns/{id}/test returns 200/400 with meaningful detail. Frontend Playwright covered: login+TOTP, timezone save+reload (Europe/Brussels persists correctly), Import CSV modal with dropzone + import-cat-* chips + csv-filename + start-import-btn, no-duplicate case imports directly (no prompt) as expected, /campaigns list renders 7 campaign-thumb iframes (no crash), campaign Send modal shows send-test-btn + 2 send-cat chips (Product updates, VIP) + schedule tab note 'Time is interpreted in your workspace timezone: Europe/Brussels', clicking send-test-btn triggers POST /campaigns/{id}/test (backend responded 400 — SMTP not set — endpoint fires correctly, no crash).

integration_issues.issue: Endpoint /campaigns/{id}/test is called and returns 400 (no SMTP configured), but the sonner error toast rendered by toast.error(formatApiErrorDetail(...)) had no visible text at query time. Likely a timing artefact (toast auto-dismissed before query) since code path is `toast.error(formatApiErrorDetail(err.response?.data?.detail))` and backend detail is 'Set up your SMTP server first...'. Recommend verifying toast visually on next self-test; endpoint contract met per spec.

issues: Driver.js onboarding overlay still appears; must be removed in automation via page.evaluate for reliable clicks.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Manually verify the sonner error toast ('Set up your SMTP server first…') is visible for a few seconds after clicking Send test to myself when SMTP is not configured — code path is correct but automated toast text capture was empty.

OPTIONAL: The two-step overwrite prompt path was NOT exercised end-to-end in the UI because the automated harness couldn't reopen the Import CSV modal reliably immediately after saving a contact via the Add Contact modal (main agent may want a quick manual smoke: add contact X → Import CSV containing X + a new email → verify import-overwrite-prompt appears with import-overwrite-btn / import-skip-btn). Backend flow verified via pytest and by direct in-page fetch (analyze returned {total:2,new:1,duplicates:1}).
critical_code_review_comments: Contacts.js analyzeImport() sets analysis on duplicates>0 but does not clear/reset importFile if the user backs out via the 'Back' link — minor UX nit.
Builder.js is 654 lines — approaching split threshold; consider extracting SendModal into its own file.

sendTest() and doSend() catch blocks both rely on formatApiErrorDetail which returns a non-empty Dutch fallback ('Er ging iets mis...') when detail is null — fine, but consider a unit test on error paths.
Contacts.js analyzeImport: no client-side guard that pickedCatIds() is not sent as a stale/empty string; backend already handles this. Acceptable.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all selectors + flows verified except live overwrite-prompt UI render)

seed_data_creation: Test contacts prefixed 'test_iter17_' created and cleaned up during test runs. Company timezone set to Europe/Brussels on the default admin workspace.
context_for_next_testing_agent: auth: localStorage keys are 'clara_token' (JWT) and 'clara_company' (X-Company-Id, may be null for user's default workspace). For in-page fetch, add Authorization + X-Company-Id headers to match the axios interceptor. Import modal state: after using the Add Contact modal, clicking [data-testid=import-csv-btn] sometimes does not open the Import CSV modal on the first try — a page reload between Add Contact and Import CSV resolves it. Driver.js tour overlay must be removed via `document.querySelectorAll('.driver-overlay,.driver-popover').forEach(e=>e.remove())` before clicking anywhere on Builder or Contacts. Campaign list uses /api/campaigns and each entry with html renders <iframe> inside [data-testid=campaign-thumb]. Send modal opens on [data-testid=send-btn]; Schedule sub-tab reveals the timezone note.
